user.title: Add TorrServer
user.description: Search the local network (recommended) or enter the server address manually.

manual.title: Connect manually
manual.description: Enter the TorrServer address. Credentials are optional. Avoid sending credentials over plain HTTP on an untrusted network.

data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for a trusted server with a self-signed HTTPS certificate.

discover.title: Search the local network
discover.description: One on-demand scan of enabled local IPv4 networks. By default only HTTP 8090 and HTTPS 8091 are checked. No credentials are sent during discovery.

data_description.discovery_port: Leave empty for ports 8090/HTTP and 8091/HTTPS. A custom value checks only that port over HTTP and HTTPS.

discovery_select.title: Select TorrServer
discovery_select.description: More than one candidate was found. Select the server to configure.

discovery_confirm.title: Confirm TorrServer
discovery_confirm.description: Confirm {url}. If it is protected, enter credentials now; they are sent only to this selected address.

data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for a trusted server with a self-signed HTTPS certificate.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure TorrServer
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings. Leave the password empty to keep the existing password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to TorrServer. Check the address and network access.
error.no_servers_found: No TorrServer was found. Retry with a custom port or use manual configuration.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to TorrServer.

abort.already_configured: This TorrServer instance is already configured.

init.title: TorrServer options
init.description: Configure polling and the streaming-health estimate. The experimental bitrate analysis is read-only and never changes TorrServer settings or torrents.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant reads TorrServer. Shorter intervals provide faster updates but make more local requests.
data_description.stream_average_window: Seconds used for the rolling download-speed average. Must be at least the update interval. Recommended: 15 seconds.
data_description.download_threshold_mbps: Minimum TorrServer speed in Mbps used by the separate Downloading binary sensor.
data_description.stream_yellow_margin: The average speed must exceed the media bitrate by this percentage to reach Warning instead of Critical. Recommended: 10%.
data_description.stream_green_margin: The average speed must exceed the media bitrate by this percentage to be Healthy. It must be greater than the warning margin. Recommended: 50%.
data_description.experimental_ffprobe: Uses TorrServer's /ffp endpoint once per streamed file and caches the result in memory. The ffprobe executable must be available to TorrServer; otherwise the integration uses an estimate.

error.green_margin_too_low: The healthy margin must be greater than the warning margin.
error.average_window_too_short: The average window must be at least as long as the update interval.

ffprobe_unavailable.title: Experimental bitrate analysis is unavailable
ffprobe_unavailable.description: The experimental analysis was enabled, but TorrServer at {url} could not run ffprobe. Install/provide the ffprobe executable to TorrServer or disable the experimental option. Streaming statistics continue using a conservative estimate.
